channel.title: Projects on Marc Fargas
channel.description: Recent content in Projects on Marc Fargas

item.title: Odoo Toolbox
item.content:encoded: Command-line tools for introspecting and automating Odoo instances — field exploration, record operations, model discovery. Designed for AI agent integration.

item.title: Go Easy
item.content:encoded: Unified library and CLI for Gmail, Drive, Calendar, and Tasks — built for AI agents that need to interact with Google services without browser automation.

item.title: Surf
item.content:encoded: Control Chrome via CLI — navigate, click, fill forms, screenshot, read pages. Built for AI agent browser automation without heavyweight frameworks.

item.title: Holdpty
item.content:encoded: Launch commands in a real pseudo-terminal, detach, and attach/view/record later. For supervising long-running agents and processes.
